topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, I guess plans change, huh? I know how much you were looking forward to the surprise party, and I bet you’re disappointed. But hey, listen, it’s totally okay. We can always figure out something else. Maybe a smaller, cozy get-together or just a chill night in with your faves. What matters is that we all care about you and want to celebrate, no matter the format. Let’s chat and plan something that feels right. How about that?
